purpose: Select a quality-first GF0025-2021 sentence-authoring and independent review workflow.

rejected_initial_pilot.author: deepseek/deepseek-v3.1
reasons: Incomplete independent review and missed defects

cases: Polyphonic single characters and words, neutral tones, contextual glosses and English translations.
assistant_review: All 32 candidate Chinese sentences, English translations, target pinyin and glosses read individually. Both candidates met required readings/senses. Fable preferred for natural standalone use such as 为祖父作传; minor stylistic preference, not a general benchmark ranking.

estimated_remaining_text_cost_usd.basis: Current live catalog and measured token usage; not a quote or prepaid total. More revisions and additional senses/grammar may increase cost.

limitations: Small, non-random sample; does not establish a zero-error rate or superiority across all vocabulary.
Model review does not replace per-batch assistant acceptance, compiled-token checks or listening review.
No comparison candidate or rejected cheap-model sentence has been imported.

compiled_annotation_findings.finding: The legacy dictionary/pinyin build can introduce errors in non-target tokens despite correct authored target annotations.
examples: 长时间: 长 zhǎng -> cháng
教授 (noun): jiāo shòu -> jiào shòu
都会 (all will): 都 dū -> dōu
Red-eyes phrase: separate 红/着/眼睛 to avoid false 着眼 word boundary
Classifier 台 and other modern words: replace irrelevant archaic/variant dictionary glosses
compiled_annotation_findings.action: Curated new-only metadata overrides and corrected canonical dictionary entry preference; original records remain unchanged. A separate complete-token independent review command is prepared.
compiled_annotation_findings.independent_complete_token_review: pending additional Gateway credits; not yet run
compiled_annotation_findings.speech: uses Chinese text; annotation edits alone do not change the synthesized input
